headline: Elon Musk said he will rename SpaceXAI, the AI arm of his space company, to SpaceXSI, following President Trump's call to say "Super Intelligence" instead of AI.
score_reason: Fresh, confirmed by Musk's own X posts, but a naming change with no direct effect on products.
importance_line: It touches the staff and customers of SpaceX's AI business and shows how quickly a government order on wording reaches company branding, but nothing about the technology changes.
summary: Fox Business reports that SpaceX chief Elon Musk wrote on X that the AI arm, SpaceXAI, will be renamed SpaceXSI ("No more AI. SI, it's better"), after an executive order last week from President Donald Trump that tells federal communications to use "Super Intelligence" for the technology. SpaceXAI was only created in July when SpaceX bought Musk's AI company xAI, so this would be its second name change.
notes: Reuters page blocked (401). Read Fox Business instead; Reuters, Forbes and others carry the same news by headline. Reply element: Musk answers Trump's executive order 'Inaugurating the Era of Super Intelligence', described by Fox Business as signed the week before; no earlier story of ours is known.
